inputs: Number of future hours to check against
documentation.logics:
Analyses current spot price against a given number of future spot prices:

- minThe lowest price in the period (including current hour)
- maxThe highest price in the period (including current hour)
- averageThe average price in the period (including current hour)
- percentHow the current price compares to future prices.
  • 0% - current price is the lowest
  • 100% - current price is the highest
  • 50% - current price is exaclty between lowest and higest price
  • and so on...
